title: English Practice Quiz 0903
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A customer has waited longer than expected. What should you do first?
options: Acknowledge the delay and provide an honest update
questions.explanation: Acknowledge the delay and provide an honest update is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: What is a service-level target?
options: A defined standard for service delivery
questions.explanation: A defined standard for service delivery is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A customer asks a question outside your role. You should ___.
options: refer them to the appropriate authorised person
questions.explanation: refer them to the appropriate authorised person is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A customer follow-up is useful because it ___.
options: checks whether the issue was resolved
questions.explanation: checks whether the issue was resolved is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Which response is professional to an angry customer?
options: Calm down, it is your fault.
I will listen and see how we can address this.
questions.explanation: I will listen and see how we can address this. is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A service standard should be communicated ___.
options: clearly and consistently to relevant staff
questions.explanation: clearly and consistently to relevant staff is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A customer complaint should be recorded ___.
options: accurately, including relevant facts and actions
questions.explanation: accurately, including relevant facts and actions is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: When a customer requests an exception, staff should ___.
options: check the applicable policy and approval process
questions.explanation: check the applicable policy and approval process is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A professional apology should be ___.
options: sincere and focused on the inconvenience
questions.explanation: sincere and focused on the inconvenience is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Customer feedback helps an organisation ___.
options: identify strengths and areas for improvement
questions.explanation: identify strengths and areas for improvement is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.
